thread:
sara.ae: Quick sync — MerakiHealth trial kicks off Mon. Need to lock acceptance criteria and the eval harness before we hand to the SEs.
jon.se: 👍 can we confirm the prioritized flows? Which prompts are golden vs exploratory?
mira.se: Primary flow = patient intake -> triage summary -> suggested next steps. Secondary = billing code suggestion. I recommend a 200-example golden set (150 intake->triage, 50 billing).
sara.ae: timeline constraint: customer wants results after 2 weeks of data. Can we run 1-week internal validation + 1-week live trial?
alex.solutions: That timeline is tight but doable if we parallelize dataset prep and seed evals. Need to confirm scoring rubric now.
samir.pm: Scoring rubric proposal: 60% task accuracy (binary for critical fields), 25% human quality rating (1-5 scaled), 15% latency/throughput SLOs. Pass = weighted score >= 0.78.
mira.se: For task accuracy we need exact-match for structured fields, fuzzy match for free-text. Propose token-level normalization + canonicalization for names/med codes.
jon.se: Regression gate: any drop >3% absolute on weighted score triggers manual review and rollback. Also auto-fail if critical-field EM drops >1%.
sara.ae: Pricing question from procurement: can we provide discounted dedicated capacity if they commit to 6 months? Pricing team is looped but need usage estimate from the harness.
alex.solutions: We can estimate token usage from 200 goldens + projected live traffic. I'll put a sample workload run and post numbers.
security-bot: Reminder: customer security questionnaire flagged data residency and HIPAA controls. Private deployment may be required for PHI.
mira.se: Action: build two harness variants — hosted mock (sanitized PII) for fast cycles, and private/VPC run for final acceptance.
samir.pm: Acceptance gates checklist (draft):
- Golden set pass >=0.78
- No critical regressions as Jon specified
- Latency p95 < 600ms on Dedicated profile
- Security signoff or Private deploy confirmed
- Pricing/commitment agreed or pilot quota approved
sara.ae: For the golden set creation — can we crowdsource human labels from their clinicians? They prefer in-house labeling for domain accuracy.
jon.se: Fine, provide labeling template. Use these anchor prompts to seed: 
```
Prompt A: "Summarize intake notes into 3 bullets: problem, risk, recommended next step."
Prompt B: "Map free-text diagnosis to ICD-10 codes and confidence."
```
mira.se: Also include adversarial prompts for hallucination checks (e.g., ambiguous dates, conflicting vitals). Add 30 stress cases.
alex.solutions: Scoring config I'll run tomorrow — includes automated heuristics and small human panel for edge cases. Will post a sample scoring CSV.
samir.pm: Who owns the final pass/fail call? Recommend SE+AE+Customer PO signoff.
sara.ae: Agreed — AE collects signoffs.
jon.se: Blocker: legal asked for model lineage and patching schedule before we can run Private infra. Mira, can you prepare a short note on model versions and rollback plan?
mira.se: On it — short doc with model variants, quantization notes, and rollback hook.
sara.ae: OK action items:
- Mira: build harness variants + small doc on model lineage (due Fri)
- Alex: run token/latency estimate and upload sample CSV (due Thu)
- Jon: prepare labeling template and anchor prompt list for customer (due Wed)
- Samir: finalize acceptance gate wording and regression rule doc (due Fri)
- Sara: coordinate procurement on pricing cadence and commitment (ongoing)
security-bot: Note: flag created (#SEC-482) for data residency; security will reach out.
sara.ae: Thanks team — I'll update the deal playbook and ping legal/security if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
jon.se: quick Q — do we want automated fallback to smaller model if latency spikes? Could be part of the harness tests.
mira.se: yes include a policy test: simulate capacity loss and assert correct fallback without quality collapse.
samir.pm: I'll add that as a reliability gate in the checklist.
sara.ae: Great. If nothing else, I'll close this thread and create a GH issue with the tasks.
jon.se: thanks — moving to action. :rocket:
